_comment: Every value in targets.json / earth_features.csv points here via source_id. kind: nasa_usgs | peer_reviewed | third_party | team_doc | sample | method. 'access' records how much of the source the team actually read. Kinds: nasa_usgs = NASA/USGS; other_agency = other government or space agencies (ESA, USDA); third_party = everything else.
